issue: श्याम in 'कार्तिक श्याम और गणराऊ': an adjective of Kārttikeya (dark-hued), or a separate figure in the list.
our reading: The dark-hued Kārttikeya and Gaṇeśa (साँवले कार्तिकेयजी और गणेशजी).
alternatives: श्याम as a third figure (e.g. a gaṇa); or the pair 'Kārttikeya and Śyāma' read as one compound name.

issue: ऋनिया जो कोई हो अधिकारी । पाठ करे सो पावन हारी: अधिकारी ('fit, entitled') and पावन हारी (agent 'one who obtains', or पावन 'pure' + हारी 'remover') are open; the object of 'obtains' is not said and is taken from ऋनिया.
our reading: Anyone in debt who is fit for it and recites this gains release from the debt.
alternatives: 'becomes pure (पावन)'; 'becomes the remover (of debt)'; अधिकारी as 'an official / a creditor' (any debtor or official who recites …).

issue: The colophon: संवत् चौंसठ is '(saṁvat) sixty-four' with no century; कल्याण read as 'for blessing', not as a name.
our reading: Saṁvat sixty-four; completed for blessing (कल्याणके लिये).
alternatives: A Vikrama year (19)64 or (18)64; कल्याण as the name of a person (a poet or patron) who completed it.
